boundary: Two short process samples with automatic walking/activities; not a controlled energy benchmark or long-duration leak/soak guarantee.
persistentData: UserDefaults settings and introduced-character migration ledger only; no movement, quote, notification or voice history.
memory: Three expansion sprite sets, each 8x24 walk plus 13x12 action frames; pointer masks keyed by fixed friend/pose/facing combinations; one playback object per friend.
runtimeDiskCache: None created. Bundled native atlases are static read-only resources generated at build time.
networkAtRuntime: No remote voice playback, API calls or notification monitoring added.
cleanup: Controller teardown closes owned windows, stops playback, invalidates timer and removes screen observer.
